name: The pond
blurb: Walk around the pond, or cross after the vest.
aside: The stick at A4 is the corner, so only one shortest walk picks it up, and that walk crosses the pond after the vest. It scores −9. The way around the water climbs to row 3, takes the ball, and scores −10. The stick at B10 is a walk up the middle that never crosses the pond. It reaches the flag and scores −10.
